prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: exactly one high-fidelity desktop homepage screenshot
Primary request: Design “Quiet Studio,” a refined evolution of the existing VIZ Creative homepage for a premium architectural visualization and interior-design studio. Preserve the site’s established composition and interaction model: a slim navigation, a centered hero designed to expand on interaction, compact positioning copy, a direct Start a project action, and a subtle glimpse of the existing scrollytelling below. This must look like a shippable production website, not a poster, mood board, or speculative brand concept.
Canvas: exactly 1440 × 960 pixels, full desktop viewport, edge-to-edge website only, no browser chrome and no device mockup.
Input images: Image 1 is the required real project hero media. Preserve Image 1 exactly as supplied: do not alter, redraw, recolor, retouch, crop, stretch, replace, or add objects. Keep the entire image completely visible.
Page structure: use a restrained mineral-plaster page background. At the top, place a slim 64–72px navigation with the compact wordmark “VIZ CREATIVE” at left, small navigation labels “WORK”, “SERVICES”, “STUDIO”, “CONTACT”, and a clear understated action “START A PROJECT” at right. Below it, use a compact positioning line reading “Architectural visualization and interior design.” No large headline.
Hero composition: center one dominant exact 16:9 rectangular media well below the compact copy. The 16:9 frame should feel poised to expand on hover or scroll but remain centered in this static screenshot. Contain the complete 4:3 Image 1 inside that true 16:9 frame at its original proportions. Use only flat solid #171817 side gutters within the media well to resolve the aspect-ratio difference. No crop, no stretch, no blurred sidebars, no mirrored fill, no generated extension. The real image must remain the clear dominant media. Add only a tiny caption “SELECTED WORK — 01” and a minimal play/expand affordance at the edge of the frame.
Below-the-fold hint: at the bottom 80–120 pixels of the viewport, reveal just the beginning of a restrained scrollytelling sequence: a fine horizontal rule, a small “SCROLL TO EXPLORE” cue, and compact chapter labels “IMAGES”, “FILM”, “INTERIORS”. Keep it linear and typographic, not a card grid, timeline diagram, or technical rail.
Style/medium: realistic high-fidelity web UI screenshot; premium editorial architecture portfolio; compact modern sans-serif; precise grid, measured whitespace, quiet baseline alignment, subtle hairline rules, square corners, image-first hierarchy.
Color palette: mineral plaster #e7e4dc for the page field, soft black #171817 for text and media well, warm grey #76736c for secondary copy, muted brass #aa8c5b used sparingly for one rule or small interaction accent.
Materials/textures: extremely subtle mineral-plaster grain in the page background, matte soft-black surfaces, tiny muted-brass details. No glossy or translucent materials.
Text (verbatim): “VIZ CREATIVE”, “WORK”, “SERVICES”, “STUDIO”, “CONTACT”, “START A PROJECT”, “Architectural visualization and interior design.”, “SELECTED WORK — 01”, “SCROLL TO EXPLORE”, “IMAGES”, “FILM”, “INTERIORS”.
Constraints: restrained typography throughout; no oversized type; preserve Image 1 fully visible and unchanged in a true 16:9 frame; plausible production-ready spacing; use only the specified visible copy; no watermark.
Avoid: crop, blurred sidebars, mirrored fills, regenerated hero content, huge poster headline, decorative diagrams, technical rails, nautical blue, lime green, glassmorphism, transparency, gradients, shadows that imply floating glass, fake claims, awards, metrics, testimonials, client logos, rounded cards, generic card grids, multiple project thumbnails, excessive labels, browser frame, device mockup.
